title: Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense
summary: OpenAI expands its Trusted Access for Cyber program, introducing GPT-5.4-Cyber to vetted defenders and strengthening safeguards as AI cybersecurity capabilities advance.
body: OpenAI expands its Trusted Access for Cyber program, introducing GPT-5.4-Cyber to vetted defenders and strengthening safeguards as AI cybersecurity capabilities advance.
summaryZh: OpenAI扩展了其“Trusted Access for Cyber”计划，并向受信任的防御者发布了GPT-5.4-Cyber模型。该模型旨在增强网络安全防御能力，通过加强安全防护措施，应对日益复杂的AI驱动的网络威胁。此举体现了OpenAI在垂直领域模型部署上的战略布局。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布了针对网络安全领域的专用模型，标志着大模型在垂直安全防御领域的进一步落地。

glossary.explanationZh: 网络安全防御，指保护计算机系统和网络免受攻击的措施。
针对特定行业或领域进行优化和训练的模型。
